messages:
elaine: Quick check-in after the postmortem: we agreed on remediations for missing spans + aggregation drift + ETL lag. posting owners/timelines so it's actionable.
raj: please make this a single source of truth. list tickets & owners and I'll track weekly.
sara: creating tickets now: RDW-8001 (trace-span-loss hotfix) -> @sara; RDW-8002 (aggregation correctness tests + baseline) -> @devin; RDW-8003 (ETL latency root-cause + backpressure handling) -> @tom.
elaine: timeline proposals: RDW-8001 hotfix by 48h; RDW-8002 test-suite + dashboard cards in 10 days; RDW-8003 mitigation design in 2 weeks, full rollout in 6 weeks.
raj: @sara confirm hotfix will instrument a new counter and add a sampling flag? We need better signal to avoid blind spots.
sara: yes. adding counter observability.trace.missing_spans and a 0.1% sampler for full-stack traces. PR target tomorrow AM.
devin: for aggregation tests: building a deterministic golden dataset + nightly runner that compares aggregation outputs vs baseline. will add per-customer diffs and an alert threshold at 1.5% delta. RDW-8050 to track nightly runner.
tom: ETL lag: found a burst window where consumer lag spikes due to reserializing large payloads. plan is to add chunking + async persist to reduce tail latency. will draft mitigation RFC by next Wed.
elaine: ops-bot, can you add a temporary SLO alert for span ingest rate drop >25% over 10m and route to eng-oncall + observability?
ops-bot: alert created: TEMP-OBS-SPAN-INGEST-25. Escalation: eng-oncall -> observability. Silence window: 2 weeks.
raj: also request a dashboard card showing span completeness heatmap by region and customer. helps triage during incidents.
sara: added dashboard card to "Observability / Span Health" and linked it to RDW-8001.
devin: note on recurring pattern: missing spans seen across 3 incidents in last 9 months. proposing quarterly audit + weekly smoke that validates span counts for a golden path. RDW-8051 tracks the audit.
tom: for backfills: will require manifest & dry-run mode. also adding an idempotency token so we can resume safely. RDW-8003 will include gating for silent backfills.
elaine: communication plan: notify Analytics and Customer Success before any backfill. add a one-paragraph status update in the postmortem and ping stakeholders when migration plan is final.
raj: can we add ownership for long-term guardrails? who owns the weekly smoke?
elaine: assign weekly smoke owner to Platform QA, runbook owned by raj.
sara: hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/rdw/trace/pulls/1890 includes counter + sampler + smoke test. smoke logs (canary): ```
OK  span-hotfix-smoke  12s
observability.trace.missing_spans = 0
```
devin: implemented initial nightly runner locally, will push CI job and dashboard integration tomorrow. test suite includes top-20 customers and randomized noise.
tom: RFC link for ETL mitigation: https://docs.redwood/rfcs/etl-resilience-2026 - contains chunking approach + async persist. feedback welcome.
elaine: summary of action items: RDW-8001 (sara) hotfix & metric - due +48h; RDW-8002 (devin) aggregation test suite & dashboard - due 10d; RDW-8003 (tom) ETL mitigation design - due 2w (rollout 6w); RDW-8050 (devin) nightly runner - due 2w; RDW-8051 (platform QA) quarterly audit + weekly smoke - ongoing.
raj: scheduling weekly follow-up thread. will expect status updates in ticket comments and a 1-line update here each Monday.
sara: merging hotfix to canary now, will monitor for 24h and then promote if stable.
devin: pushing CI job for nightly runner tonight.
tom: will post mitigation PR draft by Mon; will include load test results.
elaine: thanks all. short sync in 48h to confirm RDW-8001 status and alert behavior. If anything blocks, drop a note here. :raised_hands:
raj: noted. thanks everyone.
sara: thanks.
devin: thanks.
tom: thanks!
